title: Google Meet fallback crashes when there is no destination calendar

title: Organization slug/requestedSlug logic inverted
description: Condition flipped in ternary conversion; org created with slug when billing enabled instead of disabled

title: Google updateEvent/deleteEvent fallback compares externalCalendarId to itself
description: find only runs when externalCalendarId is falsy; comparison always matches undefined; updateEvent fails with undefined calendarId, deleteEvent deletes from wrong calendar

title: Video booking references lose their credentialId
description: credentialId set to undefined for video references, reverting fix from PR #9281 that stored correct credential

title: New booking references lose externalCalendarId for destinations without credentialId
description: externalCalendarId not passed through createEvent for destination calendars without credentialId, resulting in undefined references

title: updateAllCalendarEvents catch block no longer logs anything
description: console.error(message) removed but message still built; calendar-update failures silently swallowed

title: Recurring-cancellation deletes are re-run once per calendar reference
description: Recurring event deletion loop nested inside per-reference loop, causing N× identical deleteEvent calls for N calendar references

title: Team destination calendars silently dropped when organizer has none
description: push() on null destinationCalendar is no-op; team calendars discarded when organizer lacks destination calendar

title: 22-line credential-from-DB block duplicated verbatim
description: Identical prisma.credential.findUnique + field remap appears at lines 343 and 516; should extract to helper method
